mistake_reason: At step 2, the Assistant confidently asserted that the only dinosaur Featured Article promoted in November 2016 was Spinosaurus and that it was nominated by J. Spencer, citing specific FAC log anchors and a nomination subpage. These citations and details were fabricated and not grounded in any verified source or tool output. This is a classic FM-4.1 hallucination: the agent produced precise, factual claims (including URLs, timestamps, and anchors) without any actual evidence, leading the team to adopt an incorrect answer.
